The recovery collector/verifier records eight recovery classes but does not reconcile the same canonical request after recovery through TableSession and real channel transport. ITableChannel contains only OpenAsync/SendAsync/ReceiveAsync/CloseAsync; public client methods are TableSession.SubmitAsync/ReconcilePendingAsync/RetryPendingAsync, and local receipt query is LocalTableRuntime.HandleReceiptQueryAsync.
The TableService suite raw-settlement rejection case calls room.Actor.SubmitAsync directly; it does not prove explicit LOCAL-origin rejection through TableSessionHandler/channel ingress.
No existing Player tool covers complete privacy stream scans, role-switch cache cleanup, stale binding rejection, or bounded cheat/action cases.
executionContracts.recoveryRequestContract: G6-01..05 recovered branches reconcile the same preserved canonical request and assert its command-specific historical effect vector plus zero incremental replay deltas. G6-06 FRESH_START is NOT_REPLAYED_IN_NEW_SCOPE. G6-07/08 REJECTED are NOT_APPLICABLE_SAFE_REFUSAL with no Ready session, query, retry, submit or side effects. Do not demand one new effect in refusal/fresh-start rows.

formalRunOrderAfterC03: 1. Caller independently accepts and freezes one C03 candidate SHA; do not use moving PR20/PR24 state or this census SHA.

2. Verify source/package/Unity versions and fresh ignored E:/.../build/c04/<GUID> output/log/temp roots; preserve any first failure/native exit; check current owner and Unity mutex availability before Unity work.

3. Run existing low-cost .NET suites for LocalHost/TableRuntime and targeted Unity EditMode/PlayMode P4.3/P4.4/control suites, each with distinct logs and native exits. Unity-heavy stages serialize on Local\MahjongV5P45UnityValidation; do not overlap Unity/Player Android build stages.

4. Build/run final-candidate Windows Player full match; then run each supported recovery save fault in a separate case root. Verify manifests/hashes and original per-case outputs before any interpretation.

5. Execute only the bounded independent additions needed for original-request recovery reconciliation, call/cheat Player actions, full privacy scan and LOCAL service-boundary rejection; they must bind to the frozen C03 SHA and cannot alter accepted C01/C02/C05 scope.

6. Run final-candidate Android build/device visual/input checks only when C05 tool contract and device are available; do not infer iOS. Caller stops on first unexplained failure, native nonzero, manifest/hash mismatch, missing case, wrong binary, stale binding, or unexpected Unity mutex contention; preserve evidence and report full defect list before repair.
